entities.summary: Larissa Sansour is a Palestinian artist who currently resides in London, England. Her practice includes photography, film, sculpture, and installation art. Some of her works include Tank (2003), Bethlehem Bandolero (2005), Happy Days (2006), Cairo Taxilogue (2008), The Novel of Novel and Novel (2009), Falafel Road (2010), Palestinauts (2010), Nation Estate (2012), In the Future, They Ate From the Finest Porcelain (2016), and Archaeology in Absentia (2016).
